stories.title: Welsh Affairs Committee to hold evidence session on abandoned mine pollution in Wales

stories.title: Award-winning musical Hadestown announces Chester Storyhouse dates for 2027 tour
stories.summary: Hadestown, the Tony and Grammy Award-winning musical currently in its third year in London’s West End, is coming to Chester Storyhouse as part of its first-ever UK and Ireland tour. stories.summary: A 26-year-old man has been charged following an incident on the roof of Ysbyty Glan Clwyd hospital in Rhyl on Saturday 6 June. stories.title: Flintshire assistant headteacher wins national apprenticeship award
stories.summary: A Flintshire assistant headteacher has won a national apprenticeship award after completing a leadership qualification while continuing to work across two school sites. Samantha Stenhoff, Assistant Headteacher at Ysgol Pen Coch, was named Higher Apprentice of the Year at the Cambrian Training Apprenticeship, Employment and Skills Awards on 2 June. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of rise in deepfake and voice-cloning scams
stories.summary: North Wales Police has issued a warning over a rise in scams using artificial intelligence to impersonate employers, bank staff and family members. The force’s cyber crime team says criminals are using voice-cloning and deepfake video technology to make fraudulent requests appear genuine.
